snippet.title: MemeticBox – Official Trailer | Voxel Gore Physics Sandbox
snippet.description:
Wishlist MemeticBox on Steam

MemeticBox is a voxel gore physics sandbox where everything breaks: terrain, buildings and bodies.

• GOD MODE – no character, just you and the crowd: grab, throw, stretch, hang, pin, strike with lightning, fire and ice.
• POLICE OPERATIONS – raid a hideout, storm a bank with hostages, bust a drug lab with your squad.
• ZOMBIES – waves, a city evacuation and a full night in the forest.
• GORE ARENA – a colosseum with a crowd that goes wild with every kill.
• SANDBOX – a destructible city, mountains, demolition maps and a voxel editor to build and spawn your own models.

Coming to Steam Early Access.

Developed by Corvium Games.

#MemeticBox #voxel #sandbox #indiegame #physics
